text: A decade pane is an ordinary Wayland window holding its own terminal, so a program in it talks to that terminal directly and decade adds no rendering limits. Jack ran OSC 10 and OSC 11 queries in a decade pane on 2026-11-10 and got `rgb:e7e7/dddd/c8c8` and `rgb:1f1f/1a1a/2424` back, ended by BEL. The trial is recorded on coax-1cab7b.
